verdict.rationale: VLP's Executive Compensation page says it designs, drafts and negotiates stock option and incentive plans and phantom unit plans, with US tax advice under Sections 409A and 280G. Its Emerging Growth page also lists equity compensation for startups. So the core option-plan design is clearly delivered, but only from a US-law angle. Missing for 10: any mention on its pages of local schemes such as UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP or Indian ESOPs; any non-US equity-plan capability; independent corroboration.
